studyTitle: Monveo and Shobrun reference study for future Hisabin writing
scope: Twelve purposively selected public posts: six brand and six personal Monveo-related posts. Hisabin only; not a Cahaves Cloud persona. One additional register example is qualitative context.

method.access: Separate newly launched headless Chromium contexts, English UI, UTC timezone. No personal browser, cookies, account login or stored session used.
method.sampling: Recent brand posts plus relevant personal product announcements, promotions, criticism response and support. Not random or representative.
method.counts: Live public DOM or explicitly labeled public Open Graph metadata, not analytics APIs or collector snapshots. Blank is null. Rounded displays retained without invented exact values.
method.replyScope: Only replies loaded before Related threads or Instagram recommendations. Counts can include author and nested replies. No full pagination; absence in loaded subset is not absence overall.
method.mediaScope: Captions, labels and loaded comments/replies. Full videos and audio were not evaluated.

brand.evidence: Brand Instagram links to monveo.site, which redirects to monveo.app. Site and profiles identify an expense/personal-finance app. Product claims are not audited.

personal.name: Shobrun Bagastio
personal.association: Own article states that he built Monveo; his social posts identify himself as its builder, link the product, and Instagram labels posts coauthored with monveo.app. This supports builder association; it does not establish a legal company title.
personal.legacyHandleNote: Product website still links @byshobrun. Shobrun’s launch reply says the old account was suspended. Suspension is his report, not independently confirmed.

profileDiscrepancies: Brand Threads follower count: UI 98 versus metadata 97.
Brand Instagram following: UI 9 versus metadata 10.
Personal Instagram following: UI 1781 versus metadata 1821.
Displayed product user counts differ between profiles and site; all are self-reported and are not used as verified business metrics.

sameAccountComparisons.observation: Hypothetical windfall: 94 likes/136 replies; practical emergency-saving prompt: 2 likes/reply total unshown. Views 2.4K rounded versus 97.

sameAccountComparisons.observation: Two similar money-choice prompts have different capture totals: 94/136 versus 3/11 likes/replies.
sameAccountComparisons.limits: B2 was only about 53 minutes old; B1 about two days. No fair maturity-matched performance conclusion.

sameAccountComparisons.observation: Two coauthored soft-promotion reels with keyword CTAs: 88 likes/13 comments versus 53/2. P1 has four visible keyword requests; P2 has one visible emoji comment.
sameAccountComparisons.limits: Different ages and content; full videos, distribution and fulfilled DMs unknown. Cannot infer installs, sales or causal CTA effect.

sameAccountComparisons.observation: Feature announcement 560/54; privacy response 86/27; support update 3/4 likes/replies. Reply content respectively includes product questions, criticism and other-product promotion.
sameAccountComparisons.limits: Different ages, topics and exposure; reply counts measure activity, not uniform approval or conversion.

contextualRegisterExample.paraphrase: A professional-collaboration invitation introduces the builder with saya, while replies shift among saya, aku and gw. One reply says he cannot initiate a DM to the contact.
contextualRegisterExample.inference: Even this single personal account changes register by audience. A brand should not inherit gua/lu automatically, and a promised DM requires a working process.

recommendations.status: Editorial starting hypotheses based on this user-selected reference, not a prediction of growth or a representative claim about Indonesian audiences.
hisabinBrand: Use friendly Indonesian, a specific audience problem and a useful explanation before a relevant product mention.
Use kamu or omit direct address as a starting choice; do not assume Jakarta-style gua/lu or slang is universally appropriate.
Use familiar English product terms only when they clarify meaning.
For Instagram captions, connect the practical problem to verified product evidence and one feasible next action. Do not describe unseen media.
For Threads, use one clear observation or practical question; product updates can lead directly with the change. Ask a question only when an answer is useful.
Answer questions first, acknowledge known issues, state the next step and any relevant limitation.
Use hypothetical polls occasionally only when useful for audience understanding; do not make reply-maximizing polls the identity of the brand.
Keyword-to-DM requests require actual fulfillment. Prefer a directly useful answer or available link when that process does not exist.
optionalFounder: Use first person only for real supplied experience and responsibility. The owner chooses saya, aku or gua.
Credit specific feedback, explain what changed and follow up on bugs without claiming resolution before verification.
Use verifiable milestones sparingly. Do not reproduce another founder’s emotional style, user counts, rankings or product capabilities.
neverTransfer: Monveo features, platform availability or pricing
Monveo privacy, on-device or legal-compliance claims
Monveo testimonials or founder’s personal experience

candidateProfile.voiceNotes: Gunakan bahasa Indonesia yang ramah, ringkas, dan jelas. Mulai dari satu masalah nyata yang relevan dengan audiens, lalu beri langkah atau penjelasan yang berguna. Sebut Hisabin hanya saat manfaatnya didukung fakta yang diberikan. Gunakan kamu bila perlu menyapa pembaca. Jangan otomatis memakai gua/lu, slang berlebihan, atau klaim pengalaman pribadi. Istilah Inggris boleh dipakai jika lebih jelas bagi audiens. Balas inti pertanyaan terlebih dahulu, akui batasan yang diketahui, dan jelaskan langkah berikutnya. Ajakan bertindak harus relevan dan bisa dipenuhi; jangan menjanjikan DM atau bantuan yang belum tersedia. Jangan meminjam fitur, angka pengguna, testimoni, klaim privasi, atau hasil finansial Monveo.

recommendations.candidateProfileScope: For a future Hisabin organization/profile only. Keep audience and brandFacts empty until supplied. This does not authorize overwriting an existing Cahaves Cloud profile.

exclusions.reason: Promotes another product, PomoLocked; not used for Monveo conclusions.
Not replies and not selected-account evidence.

uncertainty.verified: Account association and these captured labels are strongly supported by the inspected public pages.
uncertainty.notVerified: Paid distribution, historical follower counts, unique reach, saves, clicks, fulfilled DMs, installs, sales, retention, product implementation and financial claims.
uncertainty.outcome: I am unsure whether adopting this voice improves Hisabin acquisition. A comparison using Hisabin’s own mature posts, audience, reach, qualified questions and verified downstream actions would be needed.
uncertainty.generalization: This is two connected accounts and a small purposive sample, not a finding about Indonesians in general.

existingProfileReview.result: Suitable for the intended conditional Hisabin guidance. No change needed from this study.
basis: Hisabin guidance activates for the product/problem named in the brief.
It explicitly avoids assuming Hisabin is a personal-budgeting app or shares Monveo capabilities.
Founder voice requires a supplied author and real experience.
Answer-first replies and verified next steps fit the observed support exchanges.
The auto language setting supports the umbrella profile; the separate id candidate in this study is optional and product scoped.
existingProfileReview.caveat: Restrictions on hypothetical polls and keyword-comment requests are editorial defaults, not a claim that the tactics never work. Explicit task instructions still govern the chosen content.
